commits.subject: Honor elastic budgets for attached Guardian reviews (#62489)
commits.reason: Keep the attached reviewer's configured fixed or elastic budget when composing a pending action and carry its elastic configuration through final admission.
evidence: The attached reviewer in core/src/guardian/attached_review.rs now passes spawn_config.guardian_context_budgeting() into ComposedContext::for_pending_action and carries guardian_sync_elastic_budget into PendingReviewContext. The four changed source paths have identical blobs on the prior upstream and fork revisions.

The fixed composition control checks an encrypted call and its evidence-only output verbatim. The elastic control supplies a call too large for fixed native-tool evidence, expects final refusal at the smaller request budget, and requires the exact call to survive admission at the larger budget.
The change uses the reviewer's existing policy and preserves the fixed path. It introduces no default configuration, protocol, account ownership or publishing change.
commits.revisit: Execute both pending-action composition controls on the merged source, run the Guardian context library and inspect the attached-review call site against upstream.
